mapper.sql: encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Force2D( CASE WHEN ST_SRID(${col}) = 0 THEN ST_SetSRID(${col}, 4326) ELSE ST_Transform(${col}, 4326) END)), 'hex')
mapper.select: SELECT objectid AS id, lampcount AS lamp_count, nullif(trim(statusindicator), '') AS status, nullif(trim(lamptype), '') AS lamp_type, nullif(trim(roadtype), '') AS road_type, fixtureheight AS fixture_height_m, installationdate::date AS installation_date, nullif(trim(entity_name), '') AS entity, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.streetlight} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT objectid AS id, gtfs_id::text AS gtfs_id, nullif(trim(code), '') AS code, nullif(trim(name), '') AS name, nullif(trim(name_ar), '') AS name_ar, stop_number, point_type, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.busStop} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL
